usedFor: Freelo holds your project tasks, and GitHub gets an issue from “New Task Created” through “Create Issue”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Freelo, then “Create Issue” in GitHub
bestTemplate.why: Tasks planned in Freelo show up as GitHub issues, so developers see them where they work.

watchOut: “New Task Created” in Freelo is polling, so the GitHub issue appears after the next scheduled check.
